newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea OTC market expects 127 new listings in '97.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea OTC market expects 127 new listings in '97.

text.p: South Korea's over-the-counter stock market, KOSDAQ, expects 127 additional companies to be listed by the end of this year, a statement by the Korea Securities Dealers' Association said on Thursday.

The association said 34 companies were listed in the first half of the year, already exceeding last year's total new listings of 31. It said 26 companies were waiting to be listed by the end of August and 67 companies were in the process of registering.
The association attributed the expansion to increased investor interest and to mid-sized companies seeking better sources of financing.
So far, 333 companies have been listed on KOSDAQ, the statement said. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727-5648
